full_judgment: 4. Two sets of defendants contested the suit by filing two separate written statements  having similar contents. As per their written statements, the suit property belonged to Rahmat Ali Khadem, Latif Hossain, Abdul Majid, Harunnessa, Atimonnessa, Manik Chand Bibi and Joynab Bibi. The suit property sold in auction on 23.02.1932 for realization of arrears of rent was purchased by Karimunnessa and Amirunnessa. The suit property subsequently devolved upon Joynab Bibi's son Abdul Latif who died leaving behind son, plaintiff No.1 and a daughter, defendant No. 48. On 12.09.1932, Ahmed Kazi, the elder brother of defendant No. 49, purchased 0.66 acre of land from plot No.119 from Karimunnessa and Amirunnessa, which subsequently devolved upon defendant No.49 on amicable partition. After the auction sale, Abdul Latif, father of plaintiff No.1 took settlement of some land by a Kabuliyat from Karimunnessa and Amirunnessa on 13.09.1938. Defendant No.1 purchased some land from the plaintiffs on 20.10.1952. Defendant No.1 purchased 0.25 acre of land of plot No.210 and 0.05 acre of land of plot No.207 from the plaintiffs by a deed dated 20.10.1952, but in the deed it was wrongly written that he purchased 0.30 acre from plot No.210. On 03.10.1988, the son of defendant No.1 purchased 0.12 acre of land from plot No.167. The father of the plaintiffs got 1 anna 14 gondas share in the land of plot 167, 5 gondas 2 kara in plot No. 166, 17 gondas in plot No.210, 3 gondas in plot No.207, in total 0.90 acre by a Kabuliyat dated 13.09.1938. The grandfather of the plaintiff on 09.11.1938 transferred 0.13 acre of plot N0. 213, 0.60 acre of plot No. 212 to Rahmat Ali Khadem, husband of Amirunnessa, but the plot number was wrongly written in the deed as 112 instead of 212. The defendants got 4.27 acres of land by inheritance from plot No.170, 0.66 acre from plot No. 174, 0.51 acre from plot No. 97, 0.97 acre of Plot No. 100, 1.21 acres from Plot No.207 etc.
